segments.en: Hello everyone and welcome to EnglishPod.
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎来到 EnglishPod。

segments.en: My name is Marco.
segments.zh: 我叫 Marco。

segments.en: My name is Catherine and today we're talking about where people come from or nationalities.
segments.zh: 我的名字是凯瑟琳，今天我们谈论的是人们来自哪里或国籍。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Many people come from many different countries just like our listeners and there are specific words or adjectives and nouns to describe people.
segments.zh: 许多人和我们的听众一样来自许多不同的国家，有特定的词或形容词和名词来描述人。

segments.en: Like for example, somebody who is from China.
segments.zh: 例如，一个来自中国的人。

segments.en: A Chinese person.
segments.zh: 一个中国人。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So in your case, Marco, you are an Ecuadorian.
segments.zh: 所以在你的情况下，马可，你是厄瓜多尔人。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So that means I come from the country Ecuador.
segments.zh: 所以这意味着我来自厄瓜多尔国家。

segments.en: I, on the other hand, am an American.
segments.zh: 另一方面，我是美国人。

segments.en: I come from America.
segments.zh: 我来自美国。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So we have a lot of these examples.
segments.zh: 所以我们有很多这样的例子。

segments.en: Why don't we jump into the dialogue.
segments.zh: 我们为什么不直接进入对话呢。

segments.en: Let's see where all of the people from this international class are from and we'll be back to talk about it.
segments.zh: 让我们看看这个国际班的人都来自哪里，之后我们会回来聊聊。

segments.en: Hey how was your first day of class?
segments.zh: 嘿，你上课的第一天怎么样？

segments.en: I'm a level two and I'm loving my class this semester.
segments.zh: 我是二级，这个学期我很喜欢我的课。

segments.en: It's great being in a class of international students.
segments.zh: 在国际学生的班级里真好。

segments.en: Mine was okay except that no one in my class speaks English.
segments.zh: 我的还可以，除了我班上没有人会说英语。

segments.en: I guess it will force me to converse in Chinese more in class so at least I should improve a lot this semester.
segments.zh: 我想这会迫使我在课堂上更多地用中文交谈，所以至少我应该在这个学期提高很多。

segments.en: That's both fortunate and unfortunate.
segments.zh: 这既幸运又不幸。

segments.en: It's the United Nations in my class.
segments.zh: 我们班简直就是个联合国。

segments.en: We have people from all over the world.
segments.zh: 我们有来自世界各地的人。

segments.en: There are three Germans, a Pole, a Scot, two French, an American, a Brazilian, a Chilean, a New Zealander, though he prefers to call himself a Kiwi.
segments.zh: 有三个德国人、一个波兰人、一个苏格兰人、两个法国人、一个美国人、一个巴西人、一个智利人，还有一个新西兰人，不过他更喜欢自称 Kiwi。

segments.en: Who else do we have?
segments.zh: 我们还有谁？

segments.en: Oh we have a Moroccan, a Togolese, a Pakistani, and two Indonesians.
segments.zh: 哦，还有一个摩洛哥人、一个多哥人、一个巴基斯坦人和两个印度尼西亚人。

segments.en: That's quite the array of nationalities.
segments.zh: 这是相当多的国籍。

segments.en: Everyone in my class is from Asia except me.
segments.zh: 我班上的每个人都来自亚洲，除了我。

segments.en: There are a few South Koreans, several Japanese, Malaysian, Thai, Singaporean, Filipino, Kazakhstani, and one Russian.
segments.zh: 有一些韩国人、几名日本人、马来西亚人、泰国人、新加坡人、菲律宾人、哈萨克斯坦人和一名俄罗斯人。

segments.en: Well I think you're pretty lucky actually.
segments.zh: 好吧，我认为你实际上很幸运。

segments.en: You have the opportunity to learn so much about Asian culture.
segments.zh: 你有机会了解很多关于亚洲文化的知识。

segments.en: I guess so but I think it's going to be hard to relate to my classmates especially with the language barrier.
segments.zh: 我想是的，但我认为很难与我的同学建立联系，尤其是语言障碍。

segments.en: I think I might change classes.
segments.zh: 我想我可能会换个班。

segments.en: Don't!
segments.zh: 不要!

segments.en: Stay the course.
segments.zh: 坚持到底。

segments.en: Your spoken Chinese will be eternally grateful.
segments.zh: 你的汉语口语会因此受益无穷。

segments.en: I bet you it will even surpass mine with all that practice.
segments.zh: 有这么多练习机会，我敢说你的口语甚至会超过我。

segments.en: I highly doubt it.
segments.zh: 我很怀疑。

segments.en: Your girlfriend is Chinese.
segments.zh: 你的女朋友是中国人。

segments.en: Well there is that, yes.
segments.zh: 嗯，这倒是，没错。

segments.en: So the student jokes that their class is kind of like the United Nations.
segments.zh: 所以学生开玩笑说他们的班级有点像联合国。

segments.en: So it does sound like it.
segments.zh: 所以听起来确实很像。

segments.en: We have so many different nationalities that we're going to look at them in two groups today.
segments.zh: 我们有这么多不同的国籍，我们今天将分成两组看待他们。

segments.en: But the United Nations as you know is a political group that has people from all over the world who make decisions about politics and the environment, things like that.
segments.zh: 但如你所知，联合国是一个政治团体，它有来自世界各地的人们对政治和环境做出决定，诸如此类。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So why don't we take a look at these nationalities now on Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 那么我们为什么不现在就在语言要点方面看看这些国籍。

segments.en: Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 语言要点。

segments.en: The first few are from Europe.
segments.zh: 前几个来自欧洲。

segments.en: So these are some European nationalities.
segments.zh: 所以这些是一些欧洲民族。

segments.en: We've got German.
segments.zh: 我们有德国人。

segments.en: Where is a German from?
segments.zh: 德国人来自哪里？

segments.en: A German is from Germany.
segments.zh: 德国人来自德国。

segments.en: Okay, so next to Germany we have another country, Poland.
segments.zh: 好吧，在德国旁边，我们还有另一个国家，波兰。

segments.en: What do we call a person from Poland?
segments.zh: 来自波兰的人怎么称呼？

segments.en: You call that person a Pole.
segments.zh: 你称那个人为波兰人。

segments.en: So is this for a woman and a man or is this just one gender?
segments.zh: 那么这是给女人和男人的，还是只是一种性别？

segments.en: Yeah, it's for both.
segments.zh: 是的，这两者都适合。

segments.en: Okay, so Pole.
segments.zh: 好吧，那么波兰人。

segments.en: Yeah, a girl that's from Poland would be also a Pole.
segments.zh: 是的，一个来自波兰的女孩也称波兰人。

segments.en: Now someone that comes from Scotland on the other hand.
segments.zh: 另一方面，现在来自苏格兰的人。

segments.en: That would be a Scot or if it's a man, a Scotsman.
segments.zh: 那叫 Scot，如果是男人，就叫 Scotsman。

segments.en: Scotsman, okay.
segments.zh: 苏格兰人，好吧。

segments.en: Now this is interesting because we are mentioning the nouns of these nationalities like for example German.
segments.zh: 现在这很有趣，因为我们提到了这些国籍的名词，例如 German（德国人）。

segments.en: Now when we took a look at Pole from Poland, what would be the adjective?
segments.zh: 现在当我们从波兰看波兰人时，形容词是什么？

segments.en: Do I say I am Pole?
segments.zh: 我说我是波兰人吗？

segments.en: I am Polish.
segments.zh: 我是波兰人。

segments.en: Or if you want to use the noun, I am a Pole.
segments.zh: 或者如果你想用名词，就说 I am a Pole（我是波兰人）。

segments.en: But the adjective can be used for things as well.
segments.zh: 但形容词也可以用于事物。

segments.en: I love to eat Polish sausages.
segments.zh: 我喜欢吃波兰香肠。

segments.en: Or for example or something from Scotland, you can say I love Scottish whiskey.
segments.zh: 或者例如来自苏格兰的东西，你可以说我喜欢苏格兰威士忌。

segments.en: Or I love Scottish kilts, those skirts.
segments.zh: 或者我喜欢苏格兰短裙，那些裙子。

segments.en: Alright, so that's the adjective.
segments.zh: 好吧，这就是形容词。

segments.en: But in the case of France, the country France, we have to say as a noun, he is a Frenchman.
segments.zh: 但就法国这个国家而言，用名词我们得说，他是 a Frenchman（法国人）。

segments.en: Okay, and if it's a woman, a Frenchwoman.
segments.zh: 好吧，如果是女人，法国女人。

segments.en: That's right or in the case of an adjective, I love to eat French bread.
segments.zh: 没错，或者在形容词的情况下，我喜欢吃法式面包。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Now moving on to South America, we took a look at a Brazilian and a Chilean.
segments.zh: 现在继续前往南美，我们来看看巴西人和智利人。

segments.en: Okay, so Brazil, Brazilian.
segments.zh: 好吧，巴西，巴西人。

segments.en: In this country, there are many Brazilians.
segments.zh: 在这个国家，有很多巴西人。

segments.en: And Chile or Chile as many Americans say, has people called Chileans.
segments.zh: 正如许多美国人所说，智利或智利有被称为智利人的人。

segments.en: Some people say Chilean.
segments.zh: 有人说 Chilean（奇利安）。

segments.en: So I don't know, I guess the accent varies a little bit.
segments.zh: 所以我不知道，我想口音有点不同。

segments.en: Now why don't we move back to the other side of the world.
segments.zh: 现在我们为什么不回到世界的另一端。

segments.en: We have a New Zealander.
segments.zh: 我们有一个新西兰人。

segments.en: Alright, so many of you have heard of Australia.
segments.zh: 好吧，你们中的许多人都听说过澳大利亚。

segments.en: Maybe New Zealand is not as famous.
segments.zh: 也许新西兰没有那么出名。

segments.en: It's a small country near Australia.
segments.zh: 这是澳大利亚附近的一个小国。

segments.en: And the people who come from there are called New Zealanders.
segments.zh: 来自那里的人被称为新西兰人。

segments.en: It's very hard to say those sometimes, especially when we have to use the adjective New Zealand.
segments.zh: 有时很难说这些，尤其是当我们不得不使用形容词新西兰时。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So the student said he prefers to call himself a Kiwi.
segments.zh: 所以这位学生说他更喜欢称自己为 Kiwi（新西兰人）。

segments.en: Alright, so Kiwi was a special kind of bird that could only be found in New Zealand.
segments.zh: 好吧，Kiwi 是一种只在新西兰才有的特殊鸟类。

segments.en: And so this became a very popular symbol for New Zealand.
segments.zh: 因此，这成为新西兰非常流行的象征。

segments.en: And now people from New Zealand call themselves Kiwis.
segments.zh: 现在来自新西兰的人称自己为 Kiwis。

segments.en: So I could say I have many Kiwi friends.
segments.zh: 所以我可以说我有很多新西兰人的朋友。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Okay, Kiwis.
segments.zh: 好吧，新西兰人。

segments.en: So now if we go to the African continent, we have Moroccan and Togolese.
segments.zh: 所以现在如果我们去非洲大陆，我们有摩洛哥和多哥人。

segments.en: So Morocco is in North Africa and a person who comes from there is Moroccan.
segments.zh: 所以摩洛哥在北非，一个来自那里的人是摩洛哥人。

segments.en: You can also say I like to eat Moroccan food, which is very popular.
segments.zh: 你也可以说我喜欢吃摩洛哥菜，这很受欢迎。

segments.en: But when we talk about the country Togo, what do we call a person from that country?
segments.zh: 但是当我们谈论多哥这个国家时，我们怎么称呼那个国家的人？

segments.en: Togolese.
segments.zh: 多哥人。

segments.en: Togolese.
segments.zh: 多哥人。

segments.en: So it's Togo.
segments.zh: 所以是多哥。

segments.en: That's the way you pronounce it.
segments.zh: 这就是你发音的方式。

segments.en: Because if you look at it, I would say Togo.
segments.zh: 因为如果你看它，我会说多哥。

segments.en: Right?
segments.zh: 对吧？

segments.en: But it's not Togo.
segments.zh: 但这不是多哥。

segments.en: It's Togo.
segments.zh: 这是多哥。

segments.en: Or as my French-speaking friends would say, Togo.
segments.zh: 或者正如我的法语朋友所说，多哥。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Alright, so that's our first set of nationalities.
segments.zh: 好吧，这是我们的第一组国籍。

segments.en: Let's listen to today's dialogue one more time and we'll be back in a moment to discuss the other nationalities.
segments.zh: 让我们再听一次今天的对话，我们一会儿回来讨论其他国籍。

segments.en: Hey, how was your first day of class?
segments.zh: 嘿，你上课的第一天怎么样？

segments.en: I'm a level two and I'm loving my class this semester.
segments.zh: 我是二级，这个学期我很喜欢我的课。

segments.en: It's great being in a class of international students.
segments.zh: 在国际学生的班级里真好。

segments.en: Mine was okay, except that no one in my class speaks English.
segments.zh: 我的还可以，除了我班上没有人会说英语。

segments.en: I guess it will force me to converse in Chinese more in class, so at least I should improve a lot this semester.
segments.zh: 我想这会迫使我在课堂上更多地用中文交谈，所以至少我应该在这个学期提高很多。

segments.en: That's both fortunate and unfortunate.
segments.zh: 这既幸运又不幸。

segments.en: It's the United Nations in my class.
segments.zh: 我们班简直就是个联合国。

segments.en: We have people from all over the world.
segments.zh: 我们有来自世界各地的人。

segments.en: There are three Germans, a Pole, a Scot, two French, an American, a Brazilian, a Chilean, a New Zealander, though he prefers to call himself a Kiwi.
segments.zh: 有三个德国人、一个波兰人、一个苏格兰人、两个法国人、一个美国人、一个巴西人、一个智利人，还有一个新西兰人，不过他更喜欢自称 Kiwi。

segments.en: Who else do we have?
segments.zh: 我们还有谁？

segments.en: Oh, we have a Moroccan, a Togolese, a Pakistani, and two Indonesians.
segments.zh: 哦，我们有一个摩洛哥人、一个多哥人、一个巴基斯坦人和两个印尼人。

segments.en: That's quite the array of nationalities.
segments.zh: 这是相当多的国籍。

segments.en: Everyone in my class is from Asia, except me.
segments.zh: 我班上的每个人都来自亚洲，除了我。

segments.en: There are a few South Koreans, several Japanese, Malaysian, Thai, Singaporean, Filipino, Kazakhstani, and one Russian.
segments.zh: 有一些韩国人、几名日本人、马来西亚人、泰国人、新加坡人、菲律宾人、哈萨克斯坦人和一名俄罗斯人。

segments.en: Well, I think you're pretty lucky, actually.
segments.zh: 好吧，我认为你很幸运，实际上。

segments.en: You have the opportunity to learn so much about Asian culture.
segments.zh: 你有机会了解很多关于亚洲文化的知识。

segments.en: I guess so, but I think it's going to be hard to relate to my classmates, especially with the language barrier.
segments.zh: 我想是的，但我认为很难与我的同学建立联系，尤其是语言障碍。

segments.en: I think I might change classes.
segments.zh: 我想我可能会换个班。

segments.en: Don't!
segments.zh: 不要!

segments.en: Stay the course.
segments.zh: 坚持到底。

segments.en: Your Chinese will be eternally grateful.
segments.zh: 你的中文会因此受益无穷。

segments.en: I bet you it will even surpass mine with all that practice.
segments.zh: 有这么多练习机会，我敢说你的口语甚至会超过我。

segments.en: I highly doubt it.
segments.zh: 我很怀疑。

segments.en: Your girlfriend is Chinese.
segments.zh: 你的女朋友是中国人。

segments.en: Well, there is that, yes.
segments.zh: 嗯，有，是的。

segments.en: All right, we're back.
segments.zh: 好了，我们回来了。

segments.en: So now we have more nationalities prepared for you.
segments.zh: 所以现在我们为你准备了更多的国籍。

segments.en: So let's take a look at those now on Language Takeaway Part 2.
segments.zh: 所以让我们来看看现在语言要点第 2 部分的内容。

segments.en: Language Takeaway We're in Asia for this part of today's lesson, so we're going to start with a country called Pakistan.
segments.zh: 语言要点 今天这部分我们来到亚洲，所以先从巴基斯坦这个国家开始。

segments.en: What do we call the people from Pakistan?
segments.zh: 我们怎么称呼来自巴基斯坦的人？

segments.en: We say they are Pakistani.
segments.zh: 我们说他们是巴基斯坦人。

segments.en: Okay, so in Chicago, for example, there are many Pakistanis.
segments.zh: 好吧，例如在芝加哥，有很多巴基斯坦人。

segments.en: Okay, and moving on to Southeast Asia, we have Indonesians.
segments.zh: 好的，继续前往东南亚，我们有印尼人。

segments.en: All right, Indonesia is the country, and people who come from there are Indonesian.
segments.zh: 好吧，印度尼西亚是国家，来自那里的人是印度尼西亚人。

segments.en: Okay, very good.
segments.zh: 好，很好。

segments.en: Now if we go back to the north part of Asia, we have South Koreans.
segments.zh: 现在，如果我们回到亚洲北部，我们有韩国人。

segments.en: So we have North and South Korea on our maps.
segments.zh: 所以我们的地图上有朝鲜和韩国。

segments.en: A person from North Korea is North Korean, and a person from South Korea is South Korean.
segments.zh: 朝鲜人是朝鲜人，韩国人是韩国人。

segments.en: It's kind of like that same structure, American, Brazilian, Korean.
segments.zh: 它有点像是同一种结构：American、Brazilian、Korean。

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: And moving to the island of Japan, we have Japanese.
segments.zh: 接下来讲到日本这个岛国，我们有 Japanese（日本人）。

segments.en: So this is an adjective.
segments.zh: 所以这是一个形容词。

segments.en: We're talking about a Japanese person.
segments.zh: 我们说的是日本人。

segments.en: He is Japanese.
segments.zh: 他是日本人。

segments.en: Or we can also talk about the food, like sushi is Japanese food.
segments.zh: 或者我们也可以谈谈食物，比如寿司是日本料理。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Okay, moving back to Southeast Asia again, we have Malaysia.
segments.zh: 好的，再次回到东南亚，我们有马来西亚。

segments.en: So people from Malaysia are called Malaysian.
segments.zh: 所以来自马来西亚的人被称为马来西亚人。

segments.en: Okay, again with this pattern, Malaysian, Korean.
segments.zh: 好的，再次使用这种模式，马来西亚人，韩国人。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And I think you say Malaysian food or you say Malay?
segments.zh: 我想你说马来西亚食物还是你说马来语？

segments.en: I've heard some people say Malay.
segments.zh: 听说有人说马来语。

segments.en: I've said Malaysian food generally, but Malay I think is one of the languages, and I think it's an ethnic group as well, so you can have Malay people in Singapore, for example.
segments.zh: 我说过马来西亚食物，但我认为马来语是其中一种语言，我认为它也是一个种族群体，所以你可以在新加坡有马来人。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: And actually we have Thai people and Singaporeans.
segments.zh: 实际上我们有泰国人和新加坡人。

segments.en: So we have two countries there, Thailand and Singapore.
segments.zh: 所以我们有两个国家，泰国和新加坡。

segments.en: So Thai is the adjective to describe things that come from Thailand.
segments.zh: 所以 Thai（泰国的）是描述来自泰国的事物的形容词。

segments.en: It's kind of unusual.
segments.zh: 这有点不寻常。

segments.en: It doesn't fit that pattern that I mentioned, but it's a very important one to remember if you like to eat food from this country, Thai food.
segments.zh: 它不符合我提到的那种模式，但如果你喜欢吃这个国家的食物——泰餐，这个词就非常重要，要记住。

segments.en: Yeah, excellent food.
segments.zh: 是的，美味的食物。

segments.en: And Singaporean food is also pretty good, and people from Singapore are also called Singaporean.
segments.zh: 新加坡的食物也不错，新加坡人也叫新加坡人。

segments.en: Here we've got a very tricky one.
segments.zh: 在这里，我们有一个非常棘手的问题。

segments.en: We've got the country, the Philippines.
segments.zh: 我们有国家，菲律宾。

segments.en: What do you call a person from the Philippines?
segments.zh: 来自菲律宾的人叫什么？

segments.en: So the Philippines is actually spelled P-H-I, like Philippines, right?
segments.zh: 所以菲律宾实际上拼写为 P-H-I，就像菲律宾一样，对吧？

segments.en: But if somebody is from the Philippines, we say Filipino with an F.
segments.zh: 但如果有人来自菲律宾，我们会说 Filipino，用 F 开头。

segments.en: All right, Filipino.
segments.zh: 好吧，菲律宾人。

segments.en: This is interesting, especially for people who are native Spanish speakers because the Philippines was a Spanish colony for a very long time, and so you might hear someone refer to himself as a Filipino.
segments.zh: 这很有趣，特别是对于以西班牙语为母语的人来说，因为菲律宾长期以来一直是西班牙的殖民地，因此您可能会听到有人称自己为菲律宾人。

segments.en: He's a man.
segments.zh: 他是一个男人。

segments.en: Or if she is a woman, a Filipina.
segments.zh: 如果她是女人，就说 Filipina（菲律宾女人）。

segments.en: So this is very similar to the Spanish structure of having a gender on the end of the word.
segments.zh: 所以这与西班牙语中在词尾体现性别的结构非常相似。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And well, now we're moving on to Kazakhstan and Russia.
segments.zh: 好吧，现在我们将继续前往哈萨克斯坦和俄罗斯。

segments.en: We have people that are from Kazakhstan and Russia, and we say they are Kazakhstani.
segments.zh: 我们有来自哈萨克斯坦和俄罗斯的人，我们说他们是哈萨克斯坦人。

segments.en: So this is very common in that part of the world to end the adjective in an I, like Afghanistan, Afghani, Pakistan, Pakistani, Kazakhstan, Kazakhstani.
segments.zh: 所以给形容词加 -i 结尾在世界的那个地区很常见，比如 Afghanistan、Afghani，Pakistan、Pakistani，Kazakhstan、Kazakhstani。

segments.en: And so these are the stans, the former USSR.
segments.zh: 所以这些就是那些“斯坦”国家，前苏联的。

segments.en: So this is a very important structure to remember, but Russia is pretty easy.
segments.zh: 所以这是一个非常重要的结构要记住，但俄罗斯很容易。

segments.en: Yeah, people from Russia, you say they are Russian or you have Russian food.
segments.zh: 是的，来自俄罗斯的人，你说他们是俄罗斯人，或者你有俄罗斯食物。

segments.en: I love Russian food.
segments.zh: 我喜欢俄罗斯菜。

segments.en: All right, so we have a lot of different nationalities there.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以我们在那里有很多不同的国籍。

segments.en: And obviously we didn't cover all of them.
segments.zh: 显然我们没有涵盖所有这些。

segments.en: I think, I don't know, maybe 200 nationalities.
segments.zh: 我想，我不知道，也许是 200 个国籍。

segments.en: So why don't we listen to the dialogue again, and we'll be back to talk a little bit more about this really interesting topic.
segments.zh: 那么我们为什么不再听一次对话，我们会回来更多地谈论这个非常有趣的话题。

segments.en: Hey, how was your first day of class?
segments.zh: 嘿，你上课的第一天怎么样？

segments.en: I'm a level two and I'm loving my class this semester.
segments.zh: 我是二级，这个学期我很喜欢我的课。

segments.en: It's great being in a class of international students.
segments.zh: 在国际学生的班级里真好。

segments.en: Mine was okay, except that no one in my class speaks English.
segments.zh: 我的还可以，除了我班上没有人会说英语。

segments.en: I guess it will force me to converse in Chinese more in class.
segments.zh: 我想这会迫使我在课堂上用中文交谈。

segments.en: So at least I should improve a lot this semester.
segments.zh: 所以至少这个学期我应该改进很多。

segments.en: That's both fortunate and unfortunate.
segments.zh: 这既幸运又不幸。

segments.en: It's the United Nations in my class.
segments.zh: 我们班简直就是个联合国。

segments.en: We have people from all over the world.
segments.zh: 我们有来自世界各地的人。

segments.en: There are three Germans, a Pole, a Scot, two French, an American, a Brazilian, a Chilean, a New Zealander, though he prefers to call himself a Kiwi.
segments.zh: 有三个德国人、一个波兰人、一个苏格兰人、两个法国人、一个美国人、一个巴西人、一个智利人，还有一个新西兰人，不过他更喜欢自称 Kiwi。

segments.en: Who else do we have?
segments.zh: 我们还有谁？

segments.en: Oh, we have a Moroccan, a Togolese, a Pakistani, and two Indonesians.
segments.zh: 哦，我们有一个摩洛哥人、一个多哥人、一个巴基斯坦人和两个印尼人。

segments.en: That's quite the array of nationalities.
segments.zh: 这是相当多的国籍。

segments.en: Everyone in my class is from Asia, except me.
segments.zh: 我班上的每个人都来自亚洲，除了我。

segments.en: There are a few South Koreans, several Japanese, Malaysian, Thai, Singaporean, Filipino, Kazakhstani, and one Russian.
segments.zh: 有一些韩国人、几名日本人、马来西亚人、泰国人、新加坡人、菲律宾人、哈萨克斯坦人和一名俄罗斯人。

segments.en: Well, I think you're pretty lucky, actually.
segments.zh: 好吧，我认为你很幸运，实际上。

segments.en: You have the opportunity to learn so much about Asian culture.
segments.zh: 你有机会了解很多关于亚洲文化的知识。

segments.en: I guess so, but I think it's going to be hard to relate to my classmates, especially with the language barrier.
segments.zh: 我想是的，但我认为很难与我的同学建立联系，尤其是语言障碍。

segments.en: I think I might change classes.
segments.zh: 我想我可能会换个班。

segments.en: Don't!
segments.zh: 不要!

segments.en: Stay the course.
segments.zh: 坚持到底。

segments.en: Your spoken Chinese will be eternally grateful.
segments.zh: 你的汉语口语会因此受益无穷。

segments.en: I bet you it will even surpass mine with all that practice.
segments.zh: 有这么多练习机会，我敢说你的口语甚至会超过我。

segments.en: I highly doubt it.
segments.zh: 我很怀疑。

segments.en: Your girlfriend is Chinese.
segments.zh: 你的女朋友是中国人。

segments.en: Well, there is that, yes.
segments.zh: 嗯，有，是的。

segments.en: All right, we're back.
segments.zh: 好了，我们回来了。

segments.en: So talking about nationalities, I think there's one that we didn't mention that's very, very popular.
segments.zh: 说到国籍，我想有一个我们没提到，但非常非常常见的。

segments.en: People from Ireland.
segments.zh: 来自爱尔兰的人。

segments.en: Okay, so people from Ireland are called Irish.
segments.zh: 好的，所以来自爱尔兰的人被称为爱尔兰人。

segments.en: Irish.
segments.zh: 爱尔兰人。

segments.en: The Irish or Irishmen.
segments.zh: 爱尔兰人或爱尔兰人。

segments.en: This is a similar structure to a lot of those countries in Northern Europe like Sweden and Finland.
segments.zh: 这与瑞典和芬兰等北欧许多国家的结构相似。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So somebody from Sweden would be called Swedish.
segments.zh: 所以来自瑞典的人会被称为 Swedish（瑞典人）。

segments.en: Yes, or a Swede is the noun.
segments.zh: 是的，或者瑞典人是名词。

segments.en: So I love to eat Swedish food like salmon.
segments.zh: 所以我喜欢吃鲑鱼等瑞典食物。

segments.en: But a similar structure applies to Finland.
segments.zh: 但类似的结构适用于芬兰。

segments.en: In Finland, they're very famous for their Finnish bread.
segments.zh: 在芬兰，他们以芬兰面包而闻名。

segments.en: Finnish.
segments.zh: 芬兰的。

segments.en: So that's the way that you say Finnish with double N, right?
segments.zh: 所以 Finnish 是拼两个 N 的，对吧？

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: It's not like I finished my homework.
segments.zh: 这不像我完成了我的作业。

segments.en: It's like F-I-N-N-I-S-H.
segments.zh: 这就像 F-I-N-N-I-S-H。

segments.en: Finnish.
segments.zh: 芬兰的。

segments.en: Finnish.
segments.zh: 芬兰的。

segments.en: And now, what about people from Denmark?
segments.zh: 现在，丹麦的人呢？

segments.en: They are Danish.
segments.zh: 他们是丹麦人。

segments.en: Danish.
segments.zh: 丹麦的；丹麦语。

segments.en: And what about people from Norway?
segments.zh: 那么来自挪威的人呢？

segments.en: They are Norwegian.
segments.zh: 他们是挪威人。

segments.en: So that's one that does not fit the pattern.
segments.zh: 所以这是一种不符合模式的人。

segments.en: And this is a very interesting one that also doesn't fit the pattern at all.
segments.zh: 这是一个非常有趣的方式，它也根本不适合这种模式。

segments.en: People from Holland.
segments.zh: 来自荷兰的人。

segments.en: Okay, so Holland as a country has two names.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以荷兰作为一个国家有两个名字。

segments.en: We sometimes say Holland.
segments.zh: 我们有时会说荷兰。

segments.en: We sometimes say the Netherlands.
segments.zh: 我们有时会说荷兰。

segments.en: But a person who comes from Holland is called Dutch.
segments.zh: 但是来自荷兰的人被称为荷兰人。

segments.en: He is Dutch.
segments.zh: 他是荷兰人。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So it doesn't have to do with neither Holland, you don't say a Hollander, or Netherlands, you don't say Netherlander.
segments.zh: 所以它跟 Holland 或 Netherlands 都没关系，不说 Hollander，也不说 Netherlander。

segments.en: It's Dutch.
segments.zh: 这是荷兰人。

segments.en: Dutch.
segments.zh: 荷兰人。

segments.en: And you'll also read this on like cookie tins.
segments.zh: 你还会在饼干罐上看到这个词。

segments.en: You know, boxes for cookies, Dutch style cookies.
segments.zh: 你知道，饼干盒，荷兰式饼干。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: All right, so that's a very important one when it comes to food.
segments.zh: 好吧，说到食物，这个词非常重要。

segments.en: But we're very curious to hear about where you come from.
segments.zh: 但我们很想知道你来自哪里。

segments.en: You should try some of the new vocabulary words that we have introduced here.
segments.zh: 您应该尝试我们在这里介绍的一些新词汇单词。

segments.en: Talk about your friends or your family.
segments.zh: 谈论你的朋友或你的家人。

segments.en: But also, tell us if we didn't include your nationality.
segments.zh: 但是，如果我们没有包括您的国籍，请告诉我们。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: All right, so we'll see you guys there.
segments.zh: 好吧，我们会在那里见到你们。

segments.en: EnglishPod.com.
segments.zh: EnglishPod.com。

segments.en: Enjoy your meal!
segments.zh: 享用您的餐点！
